description: Delivery representation of the Step-11 body orientation asset for the video lesson. Geometry is taken from the reviewed, promoted Step-11 body files (LOD0 = that geometry, re-grouped). Structures are grouped into render groups (one mesh per group) whose membership follows every presentation boundary the runtime needs (regions, joint sites, joint-asset handover, material), so highlight / dim / hide / handover still act on exact anatomical sets while draw calls drop. LOD1 exists only for structures that no close-up shot frames. Tiers select files before any body download.
closeupRule: A structure is close-up (LOD0 in every tier) when its bounding box intersects a sphere of radiusM around a close-up site anchor. radiusM must be >= 1.6 x the widest site framing radius (SITE_SCALE_M x scale) of any lesson shot at that site; the elbow sphere also covers the joint-asset shots (checked by unit tests).

lod1.use: First-frame full-body overview for every structure (replaced by LOD0 in the close-up stage), and the permanent representation of context structures in the LOW tier only. Never shown for close-up structures inside a close-up shot.

skinLod1.use: Translucent 9%-opacity skin silhouette. First stage in every tier; HIGH upgrades to LOD0 with the close-up stage.

budgetsGzipKB.note: Step 12R: first stage = delivery-only proxy (intro + skin_intro); grouped LOD0 follows before the first presentation that needs it

intro.use: Delivery-only first-frame proxy: whole skeleton as one vertex-coloured mesh (no textures, no texture coordinates). Shown only on plain full-body framing until the grouped LOD0 representation is applied at the next shot boundary or cut.
